'''Minami Fujii''' (Japanese: '''藤井美波''' ''Fujii Minami'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Fujii was born sometime on May 24 in {{wp|Kyoto}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She landed her best-known role, to date, of {{an|Trevor}}, one of {{Ash}}'s [[rival]]s in the [[Kalos]] [[region]], during {{aniseries|XY}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}. Fujii is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Arts Vision}}.
